capabilities: Embed goal trackers in notes using goal-calendar code blocks
Track goals in daily, weekly, or monthly views
Enable a longest recent streak feature with the streak option
Store tracking data directly in your notes
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track goals over time, and doing it with other plugins or custom code adds setup work.
summary: Goal tracker that renders daily, weekly, or monthly calendar views with optional streaks inside notes via goal-calendar code blocks.
